blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Is poori exercise ki chaabi (key) sirf chand facts hain, is liye sawal shuru karne se pehle inhein dil mein bitha lijiye. Cube roots of unity (1 ke teen cube roots) yeh hain: \(1,\ \omega,\ \omega^{2}\), jahan \(\omega=\frac{-1+\sqrt{3}i}{2}\) aur \(\omega^{2}=\frac{-1-\sqrt{3}i}{2}\). Do sab se zaroori properties: \(\omega^{3}=1\) aur \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}=0\). Doosri property se ek term doosri taraf le jaayein to teen bohat kaam ke rewrites milte hain: \(1+\omega=-\omega^{2}\), \(1+\omega^{2}=-\omega\) aur \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\). Bari power \(\omega^{n}\) ko chhota karne ka tareeqa: \(n\) ko 3 se divide kijiye aur sirf remainder (baqi) rakhiye, kyunke har \(\omega^{3}\) ek 1 ban jaata hai: \(\omega^{3k}=1\), \(\omega^{3k+1}=\omega\), \(\omega^{3k+2}=\omega^{2}\). Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke \(\sqrt{-3}=\sqrt{3}\,i\). Aur agar kisi number ka ek cube root \(k\) mil jaaye to us ke teeno cube roots \(k,\ k\omega,\ k\omega^{2}\) hote hain. Jab bhi koi sawal mushkil lage, apne aap se poochiye: \"Kya main yahan \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}=0\) ya \(\omega^{3}=1\) laga sakta hoon?\" Aksar jawab haan hota hai.
